column1: # C++ functions the code-level model follows, for cxx_coverage.py.
# Line numbers are for commit e54c31586 (branch offer-exchange-formal);
# cxx_coverage.py fails if a function no longer starts where this table says.
#   function    name as written on the definition line
#   name_line   line number of the line that starts with the function name
#   modelled    "all", or comma-separated line ranges (inclusive) of the
#               lines the model follows; ranges must lie inside the function
#   model       Isabelle definition(s) that follow it
#   note        why the coverage is partial, or anything a reviewer should know
# Reviewer: for every "all" row, the model definition should follow the whole
# body; for every partial row, the listed ranges should be exactly what the
# definition follows, and the lines left out should be ones the note names.
